system.description:
Given enough time, you can dig up the right tool for the job.

Prerequisite: Trained in Gather Information

Effect: Whenever you would acquire a license for a Restricted or Military object, you can substitute a Gather Information check for a Knowledge (Bureaucracy) check. Reduce the Black Market cost multiplier of such items by 1.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
